ev.q: The game allows players to build constructions in a 3D procedurally generated world
Lego Worlds is a sandbox video game that allows players to build a world
The player is rewarded for collecting objects spread across the map with studs
A multiplayer option and features for world-sharing have been added to the game through later updates
a world made up of Lego bricks
Players' appearances and outfits are customizable in the game
A variety of vehicles, such as helicopters, and creatures are featured in the game
